scene.ko: 축제 거리에서 공연을 보던 현지인에게 거리 공연과 팁 문화, 불꽃놀이 보기 좋은 곳을 묻는다.

lines.en: Excuse me, is this street show part of the festival?
lines.ko: 실례합니다, 이 거리 공연도 축제의 일부인가요?
alt: Excuse me, is this performance part of the festival?
Sorry, is this show part of the festival?

lines.en: Yes, it is. There are performers all along this street until 9 tonight.
lines.ko: 네, 맞아요. 오늘 밤 9시까지 이 거리 곳곳에서 공연을 해요.

lines.en: Do people usually give them money?
alt: Are people supposed to tip them?
Do people usually tip the performers?

lines.en: If you enjoy the show, yes. A dollar or two in the hat is fine.
lines.ko: 공연이 마음에 들면요. 모자에 1~2달러 넣으면 돼요.

lines.en: Good to know. I heard there are fireworks later. Where's the best place to watch them?
lines.ko: 좋은 정보네요. 이따 불꽃놀이가 있다고 들었는데요. 어디서 보는 게 제일 좋아요?
alt: Thanks for telling me. Where's a good spot to see the fireworks later?

lines.en: Try the bridge near the old clock tower. But get there early, because it gets crowded.
lines.ko: 옛 시계탑 근처 다리에 가 보세요. 그런데 사람이 많아지니까 일찍 가세요.

lines.en: What time should I get there?
The fireworks start at 9:30, so I'd go around 8:30.
Thanks so much. You've been really helpful.
lines.ko: 정말 고마워요. 덕분에 큰 도움이 됐어요.
alt: Thank you. That was really helpful.
Thanks a lot. You're a big help.

expressions.en: Is this ___ part of the festival?

expressions.note: 새로 알게 된 것에 짧게 답할 때
